fit: No fitted parameters. Each subject cutoff chooses integer period 45–180 minimizing sum of squared bilateral knee discrepancies between the last 60 samples and the corresponding shifted 60; ties shortest. Forecast the knee pair at cutoff+15−period. Require 240 contiguous finite historical knee samples and the original eligible 15-frame target. Equal-person mean absolute error over both knees, same eligible rows and people for both models. Paired bootstrap by participant, 10000 resamples, seed 21301.
limits: One treadmill speed, previously recorded Xsens angle exports. The stride baseline uses four seconds of previous knee angles; the Transformer spans 0.4 seconds of the six joint angles.
